**Company:** Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd., a Private limited company incorporated on 29 Sep 2019, is currently **Winding up**. It operates in the Technology sector in Selangor, providing software development for small‑business accounting. Share capital is **RM2.5m**.  

**Director & Shareholder:** The company has **3 directors** and **3 shareholders**. The largest shareholder is **Director 2** with **52.17 %** of the equity.  

**Financials:** Using the latest FY 2024, revenue grew **2.5 %** YoY versus FY 2023. Gross profit margin stands at **60.8 %** and operating profit margin at **14.8 %**. Free cash flow is **RM614.69k** (positive), while net debt (borrowings minus cash) is **RM2.33m**, indicating a moderate debt load.  

**Litigation:** The record lists **8 court cases**, all where the company is the defendant. Total claim amount sums to **RM6.82m**. Case statuses comprise **4 pending**, **1 dismissed**, **1 withdrawn**, **1 judgment entered**, and **1 settled**.  

**Review Rating:** **1/5 – Very low review priority** – the company is in winding‑up status and faces multiple defendant claims, outweighing any positive financial signals.
